ES-001.note: app/EditorSource.cpp decodes with header size limits and typed diagnostics, never modifying the file; verified by tests/EditorSourceTest.cpp.

ES-002.note: Orientation is normalized once at load (QImageReader auto-transform) and pixels are held as non-premultiplied ARGB32; colour profile conversion is not yet applied.

ES-004.note: Native selection outline and hit testing follow rotation. Pointer and keyboard move, Alt+arrow resize, R/Shift+R quarter turns, a cancellable Rotate selection dialog for arbitrary angles, ordering, and Delete are available. Rotation commits one session history entry.

ES-006.note: Undo and redo restore the selection each state had (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp). Canvas history restores the source PNG and dimensions plus annotations and selection; CanvasOperationsTest and EditorWindowTest cover crop, resize and whole-image rotation.

ES-007.note: History snapshots hold immutable, implicitly shared source PNG and assets. Canvas edits create a separate encoded source before committing; undo/redo never modify a reachable prior source. Allocation is reserved before truncating the redo branch.

ES-008.note: Escape cancels a draw or move gesture; closing a dirty editor offers Save, Discard, and Cancel.

ES-009.note: The authoritative PNG compositor and atomic save preserve the source colour profile. Native tests verify profile and alpha across canvas edits and persisted PNG/sidecar reopening. Additional export formats, requested profile conversion and cross-platform golden coverage remain pending.

ES-011.note: EditorSession::recordSave() marks clean only when the raster and sidecar both persisted (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp). Atomic raster replacement arrives with the save path.

ES-012.note: A sidecar failure keeps the session dirty and reports sidecar-save-failed (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-013.note: gzip-wrapped UTF-8 JSON with the schema fields round-trips (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp). Computing the source SHA-256 arrives with the source loader.

ES-015.note: Unknown additive fields and annotation types round-trip in the core. The native source loader now also fails closed for newer, unreadable or corrupt sidecars and embedded sources, preserving the original files and preventing a writable bare-raster fallback. Native file tests cover these failures; unsupported-placeholder presentation remains tracked under editor accessibility/tool coverage.

ES-016.note: Qt Core SourceBinding requires an explicit current-raster or embedded-source choice when hashes differ. The native warning offers both validated images with dimensions and Cancel as default. Cancellation creates no session; choices preserve annotation fields/coordinates/assets and use the validated snapshots without rereading files. Core, file and native-dialog tests cover choices, changed dimensions, cancellation, snapshot stability and untouched files.

ES-017.note: Strict base64, PNG signature and IHDR limits, duplicate IDs, and finite numbers are checked before decode (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-019.note: Canvas is focusable with a visible focus ring, accessible names, a dashed two-tone selection outline, fixed-width outlines and six-screen-pixel hit targets under zoom. Native tests cover low-zoom selection. Toolbars and scrollbars are keyboard reachable; screen-reader annotation state and full high-contrast review remain pending.

ES-020.note: Temp and recovery retention arrive with the save path and recovery.

ES-022.note: Structural and history vectors pass. Shared golden-image vectors await approved fixtures.

ES-025.note: Quarter turns retain the binary64 box-coverage path; all other finite angles use exact polygon/pixel intersections with fill-before-stroke and one opacity application. Analytical diamond coverage, inner-stroke subtraction, and compositing are checked in tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp; tests/EditorSourceTest.cpp verifies a 17-degree PNG/sidecar save and reopen. Shared golden fixtures remain an ES-022 activation gate.

ES-028.note: Canvas and embedded-image limits are checked from JSON and PNG headers; readXann stops inflating at the JSON byte limit (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-029.note: Document diagnostics follow the required priority and sidecar-save-failed and raster-save-failed are reported; the source-* diagnostics arrive with the source loader.

ES-030.note: The baseline fallback convention still needs runtime observation before activation, as ES-030 requires.
